##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, but poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

##Visibility##

Good, but poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.
